nodes.name: Sklearn Orchestration Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level Pipeline, ColumnTransformer, FeatureUnion, GridSearchCV, and RandomizedSearchCV selection, callback-payload, and fitted-state atoms above estimator, transformer, scorer, splitter, and CV-search callback boundaries.

nodes.name: orchestration_estimator_catalog
nodes.description: Expose public sklearn orchestration estimator names useful for framework-level selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public estimator-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: orchestration_estimator_family
nodes.description: Return the orchestration family represented by a public estimator name.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a dictionary lookup over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: orchestration_boundary
nodes.description: Return the estimator, transformer, scorer, splitter, or search callback boundary represented by a public orchestration estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: orchestration_estimator_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level orchestration routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public-method tuple for each covered orchestration estimator.

nodes.name: orchestration_fit_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public orchestration fit payload for finite dense inputs without executing delegated callbacks.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, X: object, y: object = None, params: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense fit inputs and packages references without fitting or scoring.

nodes.name: orchestration_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public orchestration transform, prediction, or score payload without executing the method.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, method_name: str, X: object) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense method input and packages references, leaving method execution to sklearn and user-provided components.

nodes.name: orchestration_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted public orchestration estimator object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: orchestration_fitted_state_summary
nodes.description: Expose fitted step, transformer, and CV-search metadata after delegated orchestration execution.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom exposes already-fitted step, transformer, or CV-search metadata proportional to component count.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 3 and Case 4 public orchestration shells over estimator, transformer, scorer, splitter, and search callback boundaries
limitations: Pipeline steps, column transformers, feature-union transformers, search estimators, scorers, splitters, and refit callbacks are arbitrary delegated components.

The shell models finite dense public API routing and compact fitted-state packaging, not component fitting, transformation, prediction, scoring, CV splitting, parameter-grid iteration, randomized sampling, job scheduling, or refit execution.
